procedure: Resolve static, dynamic, generated child-script and constructed-path imports; reconcile all 402 explicit paths.
Use immutable exports and matching read-only dependencies. The original baseline is a native detached clone at the recorded base with the same origin.

Each file uses a new process session, closed stdin, a 300-second external bound, private HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, LLV_STATE_DIR, TMPDIR, CODEX_HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and a closed loopback Viewer control URL.
Run every manifest path on the production commit and native baseline. Repeat red files and variable cases as whole files, retaining all outcomes and runner errors.
The baseline transport interrupted after 200 of 402 files. Verify owned cleanup, resume the remaining 202 files, and reconcile every manifest path before comparison.

After the primary sweep, strengthen only the contention test outcome assertions. Verify that no production path changed, that no other tracked source references this test file, and that its child processes re-execute the same file. Rerun that whole file and its children, focused cases, types, lint and all controls on the final fixture commit.
The follow-up takes two paired full-file rounds of cleanup-scope and synchronous-lock caller tests, and two additional head runs of quiet-owner tests. Preserve the earlier observations.
